{{RemovedSandboxOnly|date=5th June 2026}} {{For|other uses of [[Unknown (Disambiguation)|Unknown]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Unknown |image-static = Unknown.png |image-dynamic = UnknownEnemyDynamic.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] ---- Originally:
[[Hardcore Mode|{{Color|HardcoreMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 49 (Hardcore) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]14,000 |speed = 2 |spawned_by = [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Stomp}}''' - The '''Unknown''' stomps, creating a shockwave that stuns towers and damages units by 1,000 damage. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Unknown''' was a high health [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It has slightly slow speed while also having high health. The '''Unknown''' has a ''Stomp'' ability that creates a shockwave which stuns towers. It also deals 1,000 damage to all [[units]] in the shockwave radius, which is enough to destroy the majority of them, with the exception of the [[Railgun Tank]], [[Riot Guard]] and the [[Executioner Skeleton]]. The '''Unknown''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]. ==Appearance== The '''Unknown''' is a large humanoid entity, taller than the [[Giant Boss]]. It is faceless and has a grey reflective body with small humanoids coming out of it. Its left leg is twisted, and its head is slightly tilted downwards. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Unknown''' still appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *'''Unknowns''' will usually spawn in small groups. If the '''Unknown''' is not eliminated within a short period of time, the ability may stun many towers. ** Because its ''Stomp'' is smaller than major bosses' ''Stomps'', it is recommended to kill the '''Unknown''' from a distance. **The [[Ranger]] is a good long range cliff tower that can target this [[Enemies|enemy]] at a distance, making it useful against this enemy. ***The [[Brawler]] is also useful due to its high DPS and the ability to knockback the enemy. ***They are also immune to stuns, making them even more useful. **High DPS towers, such as the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are required to defeat this enemy due to its high health, however they can be stunned by its ability. ***You can use the [[Medic]] to shield towers from the stun that the '''Unknown''' can cause. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseUnknown.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Unknown''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2020|'''Unknown''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexUnknown.png|'''Unknown''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This is the first and only [[Enemies|enemy]] to have a ''Stomp'' attack that is not a major boss. *The appearance of the '''Unknown''' is somewhat similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]] from ''Tower Battles'', with the humanoids coming out of its body in the same pattern. **Additionally, both of them have a ''Stomp'' ability. *During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], the '''Unknown''' had 8,000 health. *The death sound of the '''Unknown''' is a pitched down version of the [[Shadow Boss]]'s death sound. *Weirdly, the health of the '''Unknown''' was increased in [[MEGA Servers]], despite it not being able to spawn in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] without admin commands. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Unknown''' added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Unknown''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Heavy Voidling]]. Now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]] & [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]|Wave 48|Unknown & [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]]|Wave 49|[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]|Wave 50|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
